premium.basis: vs. last closing price of $58.35 on 2007-02-16 (pre-announcement Friday)

value_inflection_events.event: Unidentified trigger event; stock price surged 74.8% from prior week's close of $26.21 to $45.82. Speculation likely related to positive clinical/regulatory news for VYVANSE given subsequent high volume.

leaked_early.details: Rumors of Shire as a likely acquirer surfaced by January 13, 2007, and heavy pre-announcement speculation on February 16, 2007, indicated imminent deal.

notes: Deal was driven by Shire's desire to consolidate VYVANSE ownership post-FDA approval. Despite a broad process contacting 14 other parties, no superior bids emerged. The final $64.00 price was a modest 9.7% premium over the pre-announcement close ($58.35), though the stock had already surged significantly in the prior months due to commercial prospects.
